summary: The index is comprised exclusively of equity securities (or corresponding American Depositary Receipts (“ADRs”)) of companies included in the Dan Ives AI Power & Infrastructure 30 Research Report (the “AI Power Report”). Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of AI Power Companies. It is non-diversified.
